verdict.rationale: Kit advertises "Unlimited Visual Automations" and RSS campaigns, which suggest built-in event-driven rules, but the pack gives only pricing-page bullets with no detail on triggers, conditions or actions. The well-documented webhooks (with signing and retries) let integrations react to account events the moment they happen, though the actual rule logic would then live in external code. Missing for 10: documentation of automation triggers, conditions and actions, programmatic or API-driven rule definition, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
